gramatica.titulo: Patterns: explicar o conserto e prometer o prazo

personagens.YARA: a Brazilian woman technician (thirties, brown skin, shoulder-length curly black hair, dark navy work shirt and pants)
personagens.CUSTOMER: an American farmer (sixties, fair skin, short white hair and a neat white beard, beige wide-brimmed hat, light blue checked work shirt and jeans)

gramatica.cenaAbertura: Wide view of a bright GPS repair workshop with tools on the wall and shelves of spare parts. {CUSTOMER} walks in through the open door toward the front counter, where {YARA} waits with a smile beside a GPS display, a small round antenna and a coiled cable.

slides.cena: At the workshop counter, {YARA} holds up an old antenna cable with a frayed, broken end and loose wires, showing it to {CUSTOMER}, who leans in with raised eyebrows. A dark, switched-off GPS display lies on the counter between them.

frases.pt: O cabo da antena estava quebrado.
O problema de verdade era a conexão.

frases.en: The two connectors **were** loose and dirty.
frases.pt: Os dois conectores estavam soltos e sujos.

frases.en: The signal **was** weak because of the broken cable.
frases.pt: O sinal estava fraco por causa do cabo quebrado.

frases.en: **Was** it a big problem? — No, it **wasn't**.
frases.pt: Foi um problema grande? — Não, não foi.

frases.en: The old parts **were** damaged by water.
frases.pt: As peças velhas estavam danificadas pela água.

slides.cena: Close view of a workbench under a warm lamp: {YARA} plugs a new black cable into a small round GPS antenna, with a screwdriver and the old frayed cable beside her. Next to her, a GPS display glows with a simple green signal icon.

frases.pt: Eu troquei o cabo quebrado da antena.

frases.en: I **tested** the signal after the repair.
frases.pt: Eu testei o sinal depois do conserto.
Nós consertamos o seu GPS hoje de manhã.

frases.en: I **ordered** a new part last week.
frases.pt: Eu pedi uma peça nova na semana passada.

frases.en: Yara **cleaned** the connectors and **installed** the new cable.
frases.pt: A Yara limpou os conectores e instalou o cabo novo.

slides.padrao: It's **going to be** ready · I'm **going to call** you
slides.cena: {YARA} stands at the open workshop door with a reassuring smile, holding up her phone in one hand, while {CUSTOMER} walks to his plain white pickup truck outside and waves goodbye. On the counter behind her, a small sealed parts box waits next to the GPS display.

frases.en: It's **going to be** ready on Friday afternoon.
frases.pt: Vai ficar pronto na sexta à tarde.

frases.en: I'm **going to call** you back on Friday.
frases.pt: Vou te ligar de volta na sexta.

frases.en: We're **going to send** the invoice by email.
frases.pt: Nós vamos mandar a nota fiscal por e-mail.

frases.en: The new part is **going to arrive** next week.
frases.pt: A peça nova vai chegar na semana que vem.

frases.en: I'm **going to test** the signal one more time.
frases.pt: Vou testar o sinal mais uma vez.

frases.en: When is it **going to be** ready?

revisao.en: The repair **was** easy, and the part **was** cheap.
revisao.pt: O conserto foi fácil, e a peça foi barata.

revisao.en: I **checked** the warranty and **called** the customer.
revisao.pt: Eu verifiquei a garantia e liguei para o cliente.

revisao.en: The warranty is **going to cover** the new part.
revisao.pt: A garantia vai cobrir a peça nova.

gramatica.cenaRevisao: Golden sunset on a farm in Brazil: {CUSTOMER} sits in the open cab of his green tractor, smiling at the repaired GPS display, which shows simple green field lines. {YARA} stands beside the big rear wheel and gives him a thumbs up.
